title: backlog.py brief ID carries the 'Conduct for changes' section as text, so no worker spends a turn reading it or skips it
goal: brief ID prints the text of the 'Conduct for changes' section that selfdoc.py section maintaining prints, and its hint line says the section is already included; brief ID also prints the tested rule lines of rag.py pack --root _self --set kb-worker, and the worker role file no longer asks the worker to fetch them

run:
import subprocess as s,sys
p=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","brief","ST-uruhigy4"],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(p.returncode,len(p.stdout))
sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and "Real misses feed the eval set, every time" in p.stdout and "already included" in p.stdout else 1)

import subprocess as s,sys
q=[x for x in s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/rag.py","pack","--root","_self","--set","kb-worker"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines() if x.startswith("# ")]
b=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","brief","ST-uruhigy4"],capture_output=True,text=True)
w=open("agents/worker.md",encoding="utf-8").read()
miss=[x for x in q if x not in b.stdout]
print(len(q),b.returncode,len(miss),"--set kb-worker` before the first step" in w)
sys.exit(0 if q and b.returncode==0 and not miss and "--set kb-worker` before the first step" not in w else 1)

clauses.clause: brief ID prints the text of the 'Conduct for changes' section that selfdoc.py section maintaining prints
its hint line says the section is already included
brief ID also prints the tested rule lines of rag.py pack --root _self --set kb-worker
the worker role file no longer asks the worker to fetch them

notes: From the 2026-10-24 telemetry and query-log analysis: of 219 worker sessions in 7 days (6,729 turns, 184 USD), 103 ran rag.py pack --root _self --set kb-worker (7.0 KB), 94 ran 'selfdoc.py section maintaining "Conduct for changes"' (5.6 KB), 57 both and 79 (36%) ran neither: the brief only hints at the first (bl_dispatch.py:375) and AGENTS.md demands the second before any change. All roles ran the conduct section 186 times in the week; the text is fixed. Saves about 200 worker turns (197 calls, about 12.6 KB read twice) and about 5 USD a week; the larger effect is rule compliance. The brief holds no 'Conduct for changes' text today (backlog.py brief ST-pueudigl | grep -c 'Conduct for changes' prints 0). Also wanted, not read by the planted check: the kb-worker rule-set lines (the tested rules rag.py pack --root _self --set kb-worker prints) are included the same way, and the role file agents/worker.md stops asking the worker to fetch them. The smallest of the set, zero judgment, high confidence. Lane: sprint orchestration, EP-gzr4mmkm.
